sources.fait: "The Grand Theft Auto VI pre-load will require up to 212 GB of available space depending on your device"
Digital pre-load from November 10, 2026 (PS5: midnight local time; Xbox Series X|S: 12 a.m. GMT)
Automatic pre-load: PS5 auto-downloads on, console on or in Rest Mode; Xbox automatic updates on, console on or in Sleep mode
Release date November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (exact unlock time not used: not announced by Rockstar)

scenes.texte: Up to 212 gigabytes. That's how much free space GTA 6 can need on your console.
This is not a rumor. It's written on Rockstar's official pre-load support page.

carte.texte: "Up to 212 GB of available space depending on your device."

scenes.texte: Pre-load started on November 10, and the game launches on November 19.
To get it on time, check your free space, turn on automatic downloads, and keep your console on, or in rest or sleep mode.
How much space is left on your console? Tell me in the comments, and follow for verified GTA 6 news.
